reviews.text: I want to share that I had a good experience with North Shore Animal Hospital. I had to go on vacation for 12 days and I had to leave my two fur babies which are two cats for those 12 days. I picked up my babies last Sunday and I have to say  both my cats are in good spirits. They’re happy they look like they were well cared for in the facility. I just want to express and share with others that I had a great experience with the boarding I will recommend them and I will continue to take my babies there every time I have to go on vacation because I feel comfortable and I trust them they did an excellent job.

Our beloved dog had major health issues and age and in pain it was at the point where euthanasia was the humane option, brought her in forms filled and paid ,and was told would be given her paw print in a week. called 1 week later was told no paw print came in yet,  2 weeks later called again apparently print was never done. received a refund will never go back.
Made one phone call got right in took care of us. Took care of my pet. Very easy good people at the front desk and the doctor was excellent. Great service.

Great place, vet tech Jason made extra effort in thoroughly examining my dog Kiki and identifying the cause of a years-long health problem she’s had. She is happier and healthier now and we have better guidance on how to provide more care for her.

I cant even begin to tell how compassionate this place is! First let me say no other vet that day would take me and i was hysterical crying. When i called this office Laura did everything she could and she squeezed me in and was was trying to keep me calm over the phone. When i got there they took me immediately and Dr.Gooden was so caring and so compassionate I never had a vet so kind . And the Receptionist Laura is the most sweetest person I ever met. I was hysterical crying because my Flo( my 10 year old cat ) was dying and Laura gave me such a heart felt hugs and consoled me...that hug meant the world to me and I will never forget it! And the rest of the staff was so kind with their words...May God Bless them all for the kindness they show and Dr. Gooden for trying to save my Flo. I have been to quite a few vets over the years.  But Dr.Gooden and Laura & the rest of the staff are the most caring of them all. They dont realize the difference they make. ❤️.
May God Bless them all. I would highly recommend them!

Laura, we’re truly sorry to see that your experience wasn’t satisfactory. We understand that something must not have met your expectations. We work hard to provide a high standard of care and service to every customer and pet, and we regret that your experience didn’t reflect this. Thank you for your feedback. We take all reviews seriously and are continuously working to improve. Please contact our manager, Jen at 718-208-4303 . She would be happy to discuss your experience and address any concerns.

Dr.Rosen was thorough and helped me understand what was happening every step of the way. He was very reassuring and attentive. Do I need and the needs of my cat.  The staff also helped me with my many requests along the way with patience and reassurance and respect.Oliver is home now safe and sound.
Dr Rosen is great. But this facility is unreliable when you're in a pinch - despite being a customer for several years. Thankfully another vet was able to see my pup.

Exceptional care, Dr Rosen is wonderful. The whole atmosphere is very pro animal and everyone is very helpful. I can tell by my dogs demeanor when he walks in the door, very calm and happy. I am glad I made the switch to North Shore Animal Hospital and highly recommend to anyone looking for a competent, caring vet.

My family brought our senior Shih Tzu to this veterinary office multiple times during the final months of her life. Dr. Gooden was compassionate and genuinely tried to help manage her condition, and I appreciate the care he provided during a very difficult time.

As our dog’s condition declined and she lost a significant amount of weight, she was prescribed mirtazapine 15 mg as an appetite stimulant. After receiving the first dose, which was labeled as one tablet by mouth daily, she developed concerning symptoms including agitation, shaking, and a rapid heart rate. We later discovered that the prescribed dose appeared significantly higher than what is typically recommended for a dog of her size. This was extremely upsetting for our family.

What disappointed me most was the office’s response when we raised our concerns. We were told that the prescribed dose was correct and were advised to simply cut the dose in half, despite not having spoken directly with the veterinarian. We were also told that the veterinarian would call us back, but despite multiple attempts to reach the office, we never received a return call.

As a result, our concerns felt dismissed. There was no follow-up regarding our dog’s condition, and what appeared to be a medication dosing error was never acknowledged or addressed. During such a difficult and emotional time, better communication, follow-up, and accountability would have meant a great deal to our family.

North Shore Animal Hospital appreciates the 5-stars!!!
Made our day! Thank you

I’ve been going to this vet for a few years now. Every time I go in, it’s a different vet getting to know my dog. The care is not consistent. I went to a different vet one time because I was far away from this usual vet, and that other vet  had given me so much more information that North Shore has never told me. I was shocked about the lack of care I have been getting for years.

My dog is currently ill and I went to North Shore, and that was a mistake. I have been waiting for results about a potential life threatening issue. I still don’t know what the results are, I kept calling for information but the receptionist kept saying the doctor will call me about it. They have not. It’s been a couple days since the lab test and to make things even worse, the receptionist tried to refer to a different veterinarian for Duke to get care, even tho I had paid 400$ for one lab test, one that I haven’t gotten results for.

From my experiences I’ve had going here, there seems to be a lack of care, I will never come back. The audacity they have to refer me to a different place for Duke to get care after paying hundreds of dollars for results I still haven’t gotten.

I have been bringjng my pets here for few years and I never really had a problem, however my last visit here has been so horrible that I will have to find different vet care now. I took my elderly cat here because she was having diarrhea, vomiting as well as rapid weight loss, as you can imagine this is a serious concern! The vet saw her, they ran tests and gave me medication for the symptoms and told me I will hear back in 1 or 2 days. I didn’t hear anything so I called on the 3rd day, I was put on hold for about 20 minutes so I had hang up and call back, when they finally pick up, I am told there was a “slight delay” with the results and that the doctor is going to call me, I asked when and then I am told the doctor won’t be back until Sunday… You guessed it, Sunday comes around and nothing. I spent the whole day trying to get answers, at some point I was put on hold just to get hung up on. Finally, they tell me the doctor will call at around 4 or 5 pm, 5:15 pm comes around, I call, They are now closed! Next day, which is today, I call and they are just not picking up the phone, I am guessing they are closed. Tomorrow will be 1 whole week since they saw my cat, I got no answers, my cat is still sick and I am left feeling like my beloved cat is just a $ money sign for them.

They’re literally the best. I’ve been going here for about 17 years. I even moved and tried another vet closer to home but no one compares. I take the drive to them now even though it’s an hour drive one way. Laura is the best and Brian! Mindy was the best for many years too and I hope you are having a lovely retirement Mindy! Laura and Brian thank you for always being so kind to us and so knowledgeable and caring of all the animals. We love you! And Dr Gooden is awesome! And Dr Rosen! Love you all - mom of Hailey and Jean Clawd

Don’t trust them with your dog..They will shorten the life of your dog internationally to make you spend more money—because they are going out of business. Allergy test is &700+ and completely off. I visited North Short animal hospital with my close family friend since she got a new kitten. All of the staff were very helpful and Dr. Rosen and Erin were super knowledgeable during check up of Fondue and answered many of our questions. Dr Rosen seemed to just genuinely love animals, which was very cool to experience. He didn't seem like just a doctor to me. Thank you.

IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET DO NOT BRING THEM HERE. I learned the difference between a doctor's office and a corporate money grab. The boss here is not the veterinarian but "corporate". Over a dispute about heartworm med dosage I asked to speak to the boss. The woman who came out looked like a vet but I learned later she was the office manager. Jennifer I think. I even made an appointment with the doctor but, on her own time, she cancelled it with him and told me never to come back. I didn't do anything but challenged her decision as she is not a doctor. I didn't curse, I didn't yell but it's the usual thing when an insecure female boss is challenged by another woman. She twisted my words and made me appear that I wasn't going to feed my dog in my records.  I'll get a screenshot next time I'm at my doctor and post what she wrote. Also on the same day, they overcharged me. If I hadn't caught it no one would have done anything; Put my dog's halter on backwards so he was being walked with the leash clipped by his stomach. I bought other meds, got home, and realized they were open and doses were missing. The quality of this place went down fast.

My dog was 4 ounces over 25 pounds and she was bullying me to buy the higher 25 to 55 pound doses.  During the argument (which was probably  comedy if you were listening) I said " Give me the lower dosage because if he takes a dump and misses dinner, there's your 4 ounces". She said "oh you're gonna starve your dog?" I was thinking "is that what you heard?". so I sarcastically said "Yea right! I'm gonna starve my dog" with the requisite eye roll. .She knew very well I was being sarcastic but she ran with it. Noone yelled, noone cursed but this fragile ego didn't know how to handle a customer without being a bully. My way or the highway type.  But even so. SHE IS NOT A DOCTOR.

I'm back at my original doctor who was his doctor from puppyhood. The only reason I left was because I thought boarding and vet in one place was good idea.   He heard me, answered my questions, gave me the dosage I asked for but explained WITHOUT BEING A BULLY that the higher dosage would not hurt my dog, but 4 oz is too little to quibble about. He saw the notes and said it was unfortunate that it ended up like this, when it didn't have to.  That's what the difference is between a private practice and corporate dictatorship. A listening ear, the personal touch.  And someone should look into why the office manager didn't introduce herself because I thought she was one of the vets since she was writing prescriptions.

And "owner" who responds to these posts, please pass me by. You might even be that manager and now I don't wanna hear it, like you didn't hear me.

Please know the kind of office you are in. Ask. Take your animals to a private practice. Talk to the doctor. Get prescriptions from a doctor. Make sure the doctor is boss, not corporate.

My cat, Mittens, is very old (18-19) and he was having matting issues on the end of his back from not being able to clean himself. We tried calling groomers, but they said he needed a rabies vaccine record in order for anyone to take him. Mittens was a stray cat and we didn't have records of vaccines since he was a kitten.

We called North Shore due to it's proximity to our home and they were so friendly, accommodating and communicative. I believe my husband spoke to Laura to set up an appointment to get the rabies shot and also take care of his mats.

I was very anxious to take him somewhere we've both never been. The last vet I visited in Fresh Meadows was a disaster -- the vet and tech were both scared of Mittens, quickly wrapped him in a towel right when he got out of his carrier slowly, which made him more anxious, and didn't end up helping us at all because they were too scared to handle HIM!

Dr. Gooden came into the room we were waiting in with Mittens calmly and was so friendly. He handled Mittens like a true professional. He was gentle, used slow movements and talked softly for our entire appointment. Mittens is a skittish and nervous cat, but not violent or abrasive. He hissed that he didn't like where the Dr was touching but that was all. I think that shows what great service Dr G was able to provide.

He answered all of our questions and helped clean out Mittens' ears as well. Overall, Mittens was returned to us within 45 minutes. He was of course a bit quiet and shy at home after the vaccine shot and upkeep--but the next day he was totally normal again. I will definitely be bringing Mittens back for necessary blood work or problems to North Shore Animal Hospital in Bayside. I couldn't have asked for better help to soothe my nerves as well as my cat's!!!!!
